summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K providing a routine disclosure of total voting rights and share capital as of 29 June 2026. The filing states the company has 17,183,563,842 ordinary shares of US$0.50, with no shares held in treasury. This is a standard regulatory announcement required under UK Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules, not a special situation event. There is no indication of any M&A, restructuring, capital return, or other corporate action.
